name: beat-amen-break
about: The bank's default beat (docs/BANK.md, D142): beats/amen-break.beat read by the beat reader (pib_read) and loaded before frame 0; then the play edit. The chain 1 2 3 4 once, bar by bar, then pattern 1 again at step 64 (the chain starts over). Tempo 136, no swing, no probability, no lane, so every hit is on its step's tick. Kick and snare play their samples (sampled 0003); every sound goes through the effects (fxsounds ffff). The kick's steps are x, keeping nothing, so ea and eb are its own 32768. Worked by hand from the file's rows (fixtures/README.md, beat-amen-break).
